caption:
Trust isn't the reward for faithfulness — it's the starting point of it. (1 Timothy 1:12–14 devotional)

We quietly believe we must become diligent and reliable enough before God will use us. Paul says the opposite: God counted him faithful *before* he was — and faithfulness grew out of being trusted.

Your inadequacy isn't a reason to cancel the calling. It's proof of how far ahead grace had already run.
